acceptanceCriteria: the dispute is settled by an owner-accepted spec amendment or decision, and any resulting fix lands with a regression test
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 expert panel review, main report §4 Disputed findings (scratchpad review/out/panel-report.md). Both verifiers confirmed the code facts; they split on whether the behaviour is a defect or an accepted documented choice. Owner instruction 2026-09-25: known issues are addressed before the next release. Settle the split (spec amendment or fix) as the finding's own 'Settles it' text says, then fix or record the accepted choice. Finding text: 128 MiB aggregate source bound refuses the whole Core loop with a Go-specific message (storage high; 1/2). Agreed: `internal/contextindex/git.go:28,624-633`; the message says "native Go impact index" for a TypeScript repo; no supported-repository envelope is published. Split: go-production-kernel-migration-v0.md:244 requires the bound. Settles it: publish the envelope in the 1.0 spec and README with a qualification run near the bound, and make the message language-neutral naming the measured total and the exclusion remedy. The message fix is not disputed.

completion.reason: Settled: the owner accepted this finding's settlement on 2026-10-06, recorded as decision 0436 (docs/decisions/0436-panel-disputed-findings-settlement-accepted-2026-10-06.md at 07452b07fd8cfd4fc622ad90c673a323b3d6d495, PR beamfall/corvint#633; evidence digest is that file's sha256). The settlement landed on main in commit 93db88dc, with the regression tests the decision table names (or a documentation-only scope change). No suite was rerun for this closure.
